rite.decline: Mm, mm... Not yet, my boy. The machine only works for a Digimon that has grown. Come back when yours is stronger.
rite.explain: Mm, mm... The machine that keeps your Digimon's record can do one thing more. It can let it be reborn, of its own will. It is no end, my boy: it keeps what it learned, and starts again as a baby.
rite.happy: {color 10}{partner}{color 1} looks at you, and nods without fear.
rite.unhappy: {color 10}{partner}{color 1} looks away for a moment. Then it nods.
rite.sure: Once the machine starts, there is no way back. Are you sure, my boy?
rite.farewell_champion: It grew up well, my boy. Next time it will go further.
rite.farewell_ultimate: Few reach that far. The island will remember this one.
rite.farewell_mega: Ho ho... In eighty years I have seen that form only a handful of times. Rest now, great one.
rite.city: The whole city knows already. Someone left flowers at the door, and the square has gone quiet.
ngplus.explain: Ho ho... You saved the island, my boy, so the machine will do one thing more. It can take you back to the day you arrived. The island forgets: the city, your Digimon, your bag and your bits start again. You keep what you know: the chart, your medals and cups, your cards, your techniques and your tamer level.
ngplus.sure: What you saved on the card stays until you save again. But these days will be gone, my boy. Are you sure?
ngplus.go: Then close your eyes. We will meet again... for the first time.
qol.mansion_key_used_up: Every door in the mansion is open now. You no longer need the {color 6}Mansion Key{color 1}.
